keySentence: It is never too late to change who you are.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Scrooge helped Tiny Tim. Tim got better. Everyone liked the new Scrooge. It is never too late to change who you are.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Scrooge kept being kind and generous even after Christmas. He paid for Tiny Tim's medicine and the boy got much better. The people of London grew to love the new, kind Scrooge. It is never too late to change who you are for the better. Scrooge became like a second father to little Tiny Tim. He proved that anyone can change when they open their heart.
